identificationModule.briefTitle: Lymph Node Ratio and Kras Mutation in R Colon Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Lymph Node Ratio and Kras Mutation in Risk Stratification of Colon Cancer

descriptionModule.briefSummary: clinical impact of LN ratio with Kras expression in colon cancer
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: LNR and K ras were evaluated with correlated with different clinicopathological parameters of the patients, PFS and OS.

armGroups.label: patients
armGroups.description: LNR measured by (number of metastatic lymph nodes/total number of lymph nodes excised). and K ras (polymerase chain reaction (PCR) and pyrosequencing targeted for KRAS codons 12-13 was performed )

primaryOutcomes.measure: LNR and K ras were evaluated with correlated with different clinicopathological parameters (Gender, CEA, tumor size, tumor grade and response to treatment).

secondaryOutcomes.measure: LNR and K ras were evaluated and ASSOCIATION with PFS and OS.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Stage III colon cancer

Exclusion Criteria:

* Stage I, II, IV
